name: W Florence
positioning: A design-led W opposite Santa Maria Novella in Florence's historic center, set in a rare 20th-century building with 1970s-inspired AvroKO interiors and a seasonal rooftop looking toward the Duomo
best_for: Design lovers who want a contemporary base for walking Florence's historic center
Couples who want a rooftop and a playful, social hotel scene

facts.text: The hotel is a five-minute walk to the Duomo, Santa Maria Novella Station and the Medici Chapel.
The 1970s-inspired interiors were designed by AvroKO.
The facade has vertical fluted steel moldings and bronze accents.
Room headboards have an optical illusion effect made by lights and mirrors.
Bathrooms are stocked with Davines bath products.
A curated signature Mix Bar is in every room.
The Supreme Suite has a Florentine wine window.
The Penthouse Suite terrace has outdoor lounge seating, sunbeds and a dining table for eight.
The Wellness area has a relax lounge, steam room and sauna.
The FIT gym is equipped with Technogym equipment.
The Whatever/Whenever service handles requests from midnight cravings to last-minute fashion fixes.
Akira Back is a Japanese restaurant with a Korean edge.

highlights.text: Zefiro Rooftop has views from Santa Maria Novella to the Duomo.
The reception has a custom mural of a Florentine garden with exotic animals once owned by the Medici family.
The building is one of the few examples of 20th-century architecture in Florence.
The Penthouse Suite opens to views of the Duomo and the Cappelle Medicee.
The hotel is opposite Santa Maria Novella, within Florence's historic center.

considerations.text: There is no full spa; the wellness area has a sauna, steam bath and relaxation room.
Rooms do not permit rollaway beds.
